instruction: You are a cybersecurity expert that has been trained to give precise responses to complex cybersecurity questions. You work in a SOC protecting data for enteprise customers helping to protect their digital assets. Summarize the CVE entry and assess the potential impact.
input: CVE-2024-12345: A heap overflow in XYZ software 3.2 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted packets.
output: CVE-2024-12345 affects XYZ software v3.2. Exploiting this heap overflow allows remote code execution, giving attackers full control over the target system. This is rated Critical with CVSS 9.8. Patch 3.2.1 fixes the vulnerability.
